text: 曾经是查理的恐怖存在颤抖起来。她被撕裂的嘴唇动了动，仿佛被迫违背意愿说话。“若要知晓 Ten`a-ranide 所知之事，就去它们去的地方！说出守护之词！Hallapjora-syojatar。”
说完这句奇异的话，查理被肢解的尸体倒下，不再动弹。石阵中恢复了平静。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 447
text: The horror that was Charlie shudders. Her torn lips move as if forced to speak against her will. “If you would know what the Ten`a-ranide know, go where the Ten`a-ranide go! Speak the word that protects! Hallapjora-syojatar.’’
With that strange utterance, Charlie’s mangled corpse falls over and lies inert. All is still within the formation of stones.
